_about: Hugo von Hofmannsthal. Bloom's Western Canon (1994) lists: Poems and Verse Plays; Selected Plays and Libretti. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 under Adam's Bloom-only ruling; each row is US public domain (title page, Gutenberg header or IA metadata read, recorded in _bloom).

hofmannsthal-lyrical-poems: The Lyrical Poems of Hugo von Hofmannsthal
hofmannsthal-electra: Electra: a tragedy in one act
hofmannsthal-ariadne-on-naxos: Ariadne on Naxos: opera in one act
hofmannsthal-der-rosenkavalier: Der Rosenkavalier (The Rose-Bearer): comedy for music in three acts

hofmannsthal-lyrical-poems.evidence: djvu title page read: "translated from the German with an Introduction by Charles Wharton Stork. New Haven: Yale University Press; London: Humphrey Milford, Oxford University Press, MDCCCCXVIII". Google scan, americana, no lending flag.
hofmannsthal-lyrical-poems.case: Bloom lists the poems and verse plays. We already hold the principal lyric dramas in Francke's German Classics (vols. XVII, XX); Stork's 1918 Lyrical Poems adds the poems as a book and completes the PD portion.
hofmannsthal-lyrical-poems.note: The Stork volume is short (about 80 KB of OCR). An alternate copy: lyricalpoemshug00storgoog.

hofmannsthal-electra.evidence: djvu title page read: "Electra, a tragedy in one act, by Hugo von Hofmannsthal, translated by Arthur Symons. New York, Brentano's, 1908"; Cornell, "no known copyright restrictions".
hofmannsthal-electra.case: Bloom lists the plays and libretti; Symons's Electra (1908) and Kalisch's Rose-Bearer (1912) and Ariadne (1913) are the classic pre-1931 English versions.
hofmannsthal-electra.note: The Rosenkavalier scan is a later Fürstner Ltd printing (imprint, not text, is post-1930); it is a bilingual libretto. Alternate Electra copies: electratragedyin00hofmiala, electraatragedy00symogoog.

hofmannsthal-ariadne-on-naxos.evidence: djvu head read: English translation by Alfred Kalisch, Berlin/Paris Adolph Fürstner, copyright 1913; translator's note says it is not a singing version. Toronto, no lending flag.
